about_the_game:
Madora – The forest has chosen you.

Be one of the chosen ones of Madora, the ancient entity of light, and embark on an epic journey through an enchanted and corrupted world, where myths come to life and the forest holds secrets that only the bravest can uncover.

Madora is a third-person 3D roguelite with intense combat, characters inspired by Brazilian legends and an innovative skill system: here, you can switch between active and passive skills at any time, shaping your fighting style and strategy in real time..

🔥 Highlights:

⚔️ Fluid and challenging combat with dodges, synergies and unique skills.

🌪️ Dynamic skill system: switch your skills between active and passive in the middle of the action.

👁️ Charismatic playable characters, such as Korá, Perê and Rhara — each with their own mechanics and narratives.

🐆 Colossal bosses and creatures inspired by Brazilian folklore, such as the Feathered Serpent, Zotz and the Fulô Witches. <- You need to think about whether you already include this or actually expect it to be in the game

🌌 Rich and immersive lore that blends spirituality, nature and ancestry.

🌿 If you enjoy games like Hades, Risk of Rain 2 or Dead Cells, you will find in Madora a unique and visceral experience, with its own identity and deep roots in national mythology.

🎁 Add to your Wishlist now!

All those who add will receive an exclusive skin at launch, as well as a special debut discount.

🌀 The forest is watching you.

Will you hear Madora's call?
